title: The Local AI Voice Studio That Beats ElevenLabs
description:
Voicebox is an open-source AI voice studio (32k+ stars) running fully on your own machine. Seven TTS engines, zero-shot voice cloning, dictation into any app, and speech across 23 languages.
The privacy win: your models and voice data never leave your computer. Built natively with Tauri and Rust, so it stays fast on macOS, Windows, and Linux. You can even give any MCP-aware agent like Claude Code a voice you own.

Link: https://github.com/jamiepine/voicebox

#opensource #aivoice #voicecloning #devtools #Shorts
